name: U-ena -Toohanabi no Shoujo-
source:
―Far fireworks―
A flash of orange and white in the sky, and blooms like a blue flower at the end. This celestial event has recently begun to appear and people call it "Far Fireworks."

The story is set in nondescript rural Junior High School. Tomoki belongs to a club that mixes Literature and Tea Ceremony, named "Kotonoha Circle."

It was the night Tomoki saw the Far Fireworks, he meets a soaked girl in the center of the lake. From there, he would spend his usual days with the girl, Yuena and club president of Kotonoha Circle, Utano Shinonome. But suddenly the accelerating unreality gradually approaches the peaceful reality.​ An unthinkable meeting with the unknown, and an impending surreal secret.

― The ■■ of the world. Even if taking her hand eventually changes the world, I... ー.

A summer that felt like an eternity at the moment the two passed by each other. 
Even now, I pray to the skies, and wished that those times could've lasted forever.

[Edited From the [url=https://en.u-ena.com/story]official site[/url]]
